name: Susanna Mellentien
biography: Susanna Mellentien, often referred to as 'Queen Bottom Belly', was one of the four Queens of the 1878 Fireburn rebellion. Like Mary, Agnes, and Mathilda, she was a leader in the labor revolt that demanded better working conditions and wages for the formally enslaved people of St. Croix.
notes: She is remembered as a powerful matriarch who stood against the oppressive labor system that persisted even after the 1848 emancipation.
